note: Estimates only: each service's own price, shown before a charge, wins. verified=true = read on the vendor's own pricing page on checked_at; verified=false = docs, press or in-app observation, re-check before trusting (creator/RESEARCH.md).

kling-video-v3_0_omni.label: Kling 3.0
kling-video-v3_0_omni.source: credits/s: observed in the Kling app (5 s 1080p = 60 credits) and Kling's MCP guide as quoted by third parties (with native audio: 1080p 12, 720p 9; without: 8 / 6). MCP spends paid credits only (no bonus credits, no off-peak free generation); non-members get one task at a time. Yuan per credit is from the membership price, not an official per-credit price. kling.ai/app/mcp/guide did not render for a fetch.

MiniMax-Hailuo-02.label: Hailuo 02
MiniMax-Hailuo-02.source: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo (USD, api.minimax.io, the adapter's default host) and https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md (CNY, China platform; its keys need MINIMAX_API_BASE). Both list Hailuo 02 under 'legacy/historical' models; MiniMax-H3 (per-second, V2 API) is current and not wired in yet. Model, 6/10 s at 768P and 6 s at 1080P confirmed on https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/video-generation-t2v.

veo-3.1-fast.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
veo-3.1-fast.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (audio included, billed only when a video is generated); durations and '1080p (8s length only)' from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/veo. Model ids are still *-preview.

seedance-2.label: Seedance (Ark API)
seedance-2.source: Press reports of the Ark price list (2026-03-04: ¥46 per million tokens without video input, ≈308,880 tokens per 15 s 720p ≈ ¥0.95/s; ¥28 with video input), e.g. https://finance.sina.com.cn/tech/digi/2026-03-04/doc-inhpvpqk3851254.shtml. The Volcengine docs pages did not render for a fetch. At that time Ark listed Seedance 2.0 API access as 'coming soon'. The api_model id comes from a reseller: check it in your Ark console.
